1.consolidated_definition: Respecto al ganado porcino, alternan por la ruralía del país, como términos equivalentes, con eco general en las zonas urbanas, puerco, ca y lechón, na, preferidos comúnmente uno y otro a cerdo, da: “Tengo dos puerquitos, …dos lechonsitos.” Agüero.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Respecto a the pig population, in rural areas of the country, terms such as "piercino", "ca", and "lechón" are used interchangeably with "cerdo", having a general echo in urban zones, with "piercino" and "lechón" being commonly preferred over "cerdo": "I have two piglets, ...two little pigs." Agüero.
